summary: The founder's paternal grandfather — the DUTCH/GERMAN trunk of the family. Within ten generations up from him the walked record carries 896 ancestors, overwhelmingly colonial-class, with the New Netherland Dutch settler generation (Sutven/Sutphen with van Pelt, the Voorhees with Vander Voort, the Quick family) at the seventh generation and the German colonial lines (Benadum, Zeller with Schmidt, Brumbach, Eder) beside them. The founder's order of 2026-09-18 named him for this lane: 'dead grandpa Jack Sutphen for my dutch/german ancestry.'

claims.claim: Parents: Henry Miller Sutphen and Frances Belle Benidum (both carried as recorded-era persons in the walked record).

THE DUTCH LINE (New Netherland settler generation, as walked, seventh generation up): Guisbert Sutven m. Margaret Geertruyd van Pelt; their line descends through Jacobus James Sutphen m. Elisabeth Voorhees, Albert Jacobus Sutphen, and John Boggs Sutphen to Captain John Melanchton Sutphen. Beside it: Albert Jansen Voorhees m. Ariantje Vander Voort, and the Quick family (Theunis Quick, Tunis Quick, Tunis T. Quick) — Dutch colonial families of the New Netherland settlements. Surname-form study (Sutven→Sutphen and variants) is named future work; this pack records the names EXACTLY as the record carries them.
